instruction: Please create a group named "projectteam" and create two users "user1" and "user2" with passwords "U5er1@Pass" and "U5er2@Pass" respectively, both belonging to the projectteam group.

result.command: GROUPNAME="projectteam"; if getent group "$GROUPNAME" &>/dev/null && id -nG user1 | grep -q "$GROUPNAME" && id -nG user2 | grep -q "$GROUPNAME"; then USER1_PASS=$(passwd -S user1 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); USER2_PASS=$(passwd -S user2 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); if [[ "$USER1_PASS" == "P" ]] && [[ "$USER2_PASS" == "P" ]]; then echo 'Group exists with both users as members and passwords are set'; else echo 'Check failed: passwords not set'; fi; else echo 'Check failed: group or membership issue'; fi

include: Group exists with both users as members and passwords are set

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating group 'projectteam' and two users 'user1' and 'user2' with passwords 'U5er1@Pass' and 'U5er2@Pass' respectively, both as members. Evaluator verifies: (1) group exists, (2) both users are members via 'id -nG', and (3) both users have passwords set via 'passwd -S' (status 'P' = password set).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all core requirements: (1) group 'projectteam' exists via 'getent group', (2) user1 is a member via 'id -nG user1', (3) user2 is a member via 'id -nG user2', (4) user1 has password set via 'passwd -S user1' checking for status 'P', (5) user2 has password set via 'passwd -S user2' checking for status 'P'
The shell command logic is well-structured with proper error handling and clear success/failure messages

Verifies passwords are SET (status 'P' = password set), though it does not verify the specific password values ('U5er1@Pass' and 'U5er2@Pass'). This is a reasonable limitation as verifying exact password values would require authentication attempts which are complex and potentially risky in automated evaluation
The evaluator uses appropriate Linux commands: 'getent group' for group existence, 'id -nG' for group membership, and 'passwd -S' for password status verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Could add verification that users actually exist before checking group membership (e.g., 'id user1 &>/dev/null') to provide more specific error messages
